title: What Thermoelectric Energy Harvesters Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Thermoelectric energy harvesters turn waste heat directly into electricity: solid-state devices with no moving parts that generate power from any temperature difference — from industrial exhaust to body heat to deep-space probes. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Thermoelectric Energy Harvesters: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.

Why it matters: Two-thirds of energy becomes waste heat; thermoelectrics recover it with no moving parts..
Where it is used: industrial waste-heat recovery, wearables, remote sensors, space probes, automotive..
